biotools.summary: Dogme is a Nextflow-based workflow for processing Oxford Nanopore Technologies (ONT) RNA and DNA sequencing data, automating steps from basecalling to transcript quantification. The pipeline supports various ONT sequencing data types and facilitates the detection of RNA and DNA modifications.
